decisions.reason: As a cutting and creasing finisher it remains close to the firm's core postpress know-how, and its survival into 2025 gives the firm more scope to learn from installations and improve it rather than withdraw it.

The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's existing workflow and finishing capabilities, so the firm has strong absorptive capacity to refine and sell it through its established portfolio.

The B2-format multifinisher is both strategically important and highly related to the firm's established systems business, which makes continued support and incremental development the more likely choice.
This folding add-on unit is tightly linked to the installed base and already had a concrete customer application, so the firm can readily absorb market feedback and keep it as a complementary offer.
